entries.name: homer
entries.productSummary: Homer is a static homepage for self-hosted services: a YAML-configured dashboard of service tiles with search and theming.

entries.name: conduit
entries.productSummary: Conduit is a Medium-style social blogging platform: write, favorite, and comment on articles and follow authors.

entries.name: midday
entries.productSummary: Midday is an all-in-one financial management platform for freelancers and small businesses: track transactions, send invoices, and see business health at a glance.
importantFeatures: invoicing
transactions

entries.name: excalidraw
entries.productSummary: Excalidraw is a virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn-style diagrams: sketch shapes, connect them with arrows, and export the result as an image.
importantFeatures: Draw and label several shapes, then connect them with arrows to make a diagram
Select and rearrange diagram elements while demonstrating undo and redo
Switch the canvas theme and export the finished drawing as an image

entries.name: cyberchef
entries.productSummary: CyberChef is a web app for encoding, encryption, and data analysis: build a recipe of operations and run input through it to see the transformed output.
importantFeatures: Paste sample input, add an encoding operation to the recipe, and inspect the transformed output
Chain multiple recipe operations and reorder or disable one to show the output updating
Use Magic or operation search to identify and decode an encoded sample

entries.name: calcom
entries.productSummary: Cal.com is an open-source scheduling platform: share booking links, let people pick an available time, and manage event types and availability.
importantFeatures: Show the event type dashboard and open a public scheduling link
Choose an available time and complete a booking with attendee details
Configure weekly availability and the duration of an event type

entries.name: directus
entries.productSummary: Directus is an open-source headless CMS and data platform: model collections, edit content in a visual studio, and expose it through an instant API.
importantFeatures: Create a collection with text and status fields in the data model
Add and edit an item through the visual content studio
Show how collection permissions or API access are configured

entries.name: ghost
entries.productSummary: Ghost is a publishing platform for blogs and newsletters: write and format posts, manage drafts, and configure publication branding and membership.
importantFeatures: Open the admin dashboard and browse published posts and drafts
Create a draft post with formatted content and preview the public article
Configure publication branding, navigation, or membership settings

entries.name: ghostfolio
entries.productSummary: Ghostfolio is an open-source wealth-management dashboard: track investments across accounts and analyze portfolio performance, allocation, and risk.
importantFeatures: Show the portfolio overview with current value, performance, and allocation charts
Add or import an investment transaction into an account
Inspect portfolio analysis such as holdings, allocation, or risk insights

entries.name: outline
entries.productSummary: Outline is a team knowledge base: organize documents in collections, write with rich formatting, and search across the workspace.
importantFeatures: Browse a collection and open a document from the workspace sidebar
Create a document with headings, formatted text, and a checklist
Search the knowledge base and show a document's sharing or revision controls

entries.name: twenty
entries.productSummary: Twenty is an open-source CRM: browse companies and people, track opportunities through a pipeline, and customize record views.
importantFeatures: Browse companies and people, then inspect a CRM record and its activity timeline
Create an opportunity and move it through a pipeline or kanban view
Customize an object view by filtering, sorting, or selecting visible fields
